name: Single Value
description: A single marble has no neighbor to compare against; never halts.

name: All Identical
description: A fully matching stream runs through every check without halting.

name: Mismatch At First Pair
description: Interceptor trips on the very first comparison.

name: Mismatch At Last Pair
description: Stream matches all the way until the final pair, then trips.

name: Mismatch In The Middle
description: Interceptor trips partway through a longer stream.

name: Stops At First Mismatch, Not A Later One
description: Even though index 3 also mismatches its neighbor, the interceptor must trip at the FIRST occurrence (index 1) and never look further.

name: String Values
description: The comparator must work on non-numeric marble labels too.

name: Full Length, Never Halts
description: The longest supported stream, fully matching: all 7 neighbor checks run, none trip.
